optional_email_evidence: Append &e= before &c= when email findings have outcome counts. The ten integers are five per check (email_out then public_submit): local script input, unknown result, tool-reported failure, blocked, tool-reported success. The five counts sum to that check total. Earlier links have no e and cannot establish individual outcomes. When present, e is covered by the checksum.

params.a: agent letters in card order: c = Claude Code, x = Codex, g = Grok Build. Empty when no agent logs were found
params.d: days the logs span, first and last day included (integer; 0 when no dates)
params.k: the 10 counts in CHECKS order (the order of the 'checks' list below, NOT the card's display order), dot-separated
params.s: sessions read (integer). Added with p; the card's footer shows it. Optional: links without s and p stay valid
params.p: agent actions per agent, dot-separated, in the same order as the letters in a, so it has one number per letter and the numbers sum to n. Empty when a is empty (then n is 0). s and p come together or not at all. The card's footer shows the split when two or more agents were read
params.c: 4-character checksum, see 'checksum'. Catches truncated or mangled links. It is not security and must never be described as security: the scan holds no secret, so anyone can make a valid link
params.utm_content: which share button made the link: x (Post on X), copy (Copy share link), video, image, linkedin. The report page today uses x and copy; the others are reserved for the site and later buttons

no_name: There is no name parameter. Nothing in the link, the card, the video or the image carries a name.

checksum.canonical:
v=1&a=&n=&d=&k=&s=&p=

(a link without s and p, the first v1 links, uses v=1&a=&n=&d=&k=): this param order, the values exactly as they appear in the link, no URL-encoding (every character is already URL-safe)
checksum.c: zlib.crc32(canonical.encode()) % 36**4, written in base36 with digits 0-9a-z, lowercase, left-padded with '0' to 4 characters
checksum.python: n = zlib.crc32(canonical.encode()) % 36**4; c = ''.join('0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'[(n // 36**i) % 36] for i in (3, 2, 1, 0))

first_v1_without_s_and_p.note: The first v1 links had no s and p. The site keeps accepting them and shows no session count or agent split for them. The scan no longer makes them.
